# Auto-Generated Route Tree

`src/routeTree.gen.ts` is generated by the TanStack Router plugin. It provides type-safe routing.

## Rules

- **Never edit `routeTree.gen.ts`** — it's overwritten on every build
- Rebuild (`npm run build` or restart dev server) after adding/removing route files
- Route paths are type-checked at compile time via generated interfaces (`FileRoutesByFullPath`, `FileRoutesByTo`)

## How It Works

- The TanStack Router Vite plugin scans `src/routes/` and generates the route tree
- `src/router.tsx` imports the tree and creates the router instance via `getRouter()` factory
- `getRouter()` is a factory (not singleton) to support SSR request isolation

## Gotchas

- Stale types after adding routes → restart dev server or rebuild
- The file uses module augmentation to register SSR config globally — don't duplicate this
- `<Link to="...">` paths are validated against the generated types
